notes.title: Max Mustard is Part of The Game Awards!
notes.content:
Hey VR fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that Max Mustard has been selected to be part of The Game Awards for Games Who Can’t Afford the Game Awards (TGAGWCAGA) 2024 Showcase!

TGAGWCAGA is a brand new (incredibly official and not at all a parody) showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Tune in for a whole head of indie gaming goodness and support Max Mustard alongside many other brilliant titles during the TGAGWCAGA showcase:

[b]Date[/b]: Friday, December 13
[b]Time[/b]: 5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET

Subscribe to the YouTube channel and don’t miss it! 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA]Official TGAGWCAGA YouTube channel[/url]

See you there!

Toast Interactive

notes.title: MAX MUSTARD NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Max Mustard is out NOW on Steam!
Experience the award-winning VR platformer that's critically acclaimed on mobile and console VR platforms.

Completely upgraded and optimized for PC, Max Mustard on Steam includes:
- 40 levels made for VR
- Improved visuals for PC
- Wide range of headset support

So what are you waiting for? Jump into nostalgic 3D platforming like never before thanks to immersive VR! Enter the vibrant world of Max Mustard and see it for yourself!
